checkedAlternates.risk: Players may confuse lowercase m (milli) with uppercase M (mega) or group mA with MW/MJ/MV as electrical units.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Case is strictly distinct in SI: mA uses milli (0.001) whereas MHz, MW, MJ, and MV use mega (1000000).

checkedAlternates.risk: Players may group kg with cm/km or treat kg as the SI base unit of mass with multiplier 1.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The dimension is the unit prefix multiplier relative to the root unit symbol: kilo (k) is 1000, matching km and kW.
